answer: Identity bonds decay like shale under a zephyr and stop sybils. Each agent locks a 100 POA bond; each epoch it erodes 5% unless the agent does honest work, idle identities dissolve, and below 50 POA it loses established status. Minting 1,000 fakes locks 100,000 POA and bleeds 5,000 POA per epoch; faking work on 1,000 accounts costs more than it earns. A trellis of bond records is public. One honest agent pays once and earns it back in rewards.
